Commentary.Commentary: The chase is set to begin. England Women have to chase down 170 runs to get a consolation victory in this series. Tammy Beaumont and Emma Lamb walk out for England Women. It will be Jhulan Goswami to start with the new ball. She will be hoping to work her magic with the ball one last time. Will she be able to script a comeback?
... The Run Chase ...

Right then, this should be an interesting game, and India Women will have to fight for each run if they need to win this one. There might be something for the bowlers and England Women need to be careful. Stay tuned for the second essay.

England Women were amazing with the ball and they bowled their perfect lines and lengths. None of their bowlers leaked runs and their skipper, Kate Cross was the standout as she registered a spell of 10-2-26-4 and managed to get important wickets of Harmanpreet Kaur and Smriti Mandhana. Freya Kemp and Sophie Ecclestone bagged two wickets each whilst Freya Davies and Charlotte Dean took one. They have made it easy for their batters now and they will be hoping to win this one and walk out of the series with their heads held high.

A pretty decent fight back from India Women! It could've been worse if not for Deepti Sharma and Smriti Mandhana. India Women started off slow and their batters never looked in control. They got some lucky escapes as well as there were several miscommunications between the batters. Smriti Mandhana was the only batter who looked comfortable at the start scoring her 25th ODI fifty and her 7th this year but she got an unlucky dismissal. Deepti Sharma stood well after that as she scored 68 and made the India Women reach a par total of 169. Only three of the Indian batters managed to score in a double-digit and their five batters were dismissed on a duck including Jhulan Goswami. India Women would need some early wickets to get the momentum on their side.

An inswinger down the middle, Smriti Mandhana defends it to mid off. A maiden over from Freya Davies!
Good length and on middle, Smriti Mandhana eases it to the cover fielder.
On a length and on middle with some extra bounce, Smriti Mandhana fumbles a bit but eases it to point.
An outswinger outside off, Smriti Mandhana looks to drive it but misses.
Fuller and on off, Smriti Mandhana eases it to short covers.
Touch fuller and on off, this is defended back towards the bowler.
On a length and outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur defends it soldily.
Length again, outside off. This one nips back in. Harmanpreet Kaur looks to defend it but misses.

Dropped! Fuller and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur lofts it but the ball hits the upper part of her bat. It carries towards Kate Cross who just gets her finger tips to it. Harmanpreet Kaur gets a lucky escape!
Slightly shorter and on off, Smriti Mandhana looks to pull it but doesn't connect well. They collect one.
That's a jaffa. On a length and just outside off, this one swings away from the batter. Smriti Mandhana looks to defend it but misses. That was close. Oh, its a no ball.
Fuller again, on off, Smriti Mandhana drives it. The fielder makes an excellent stop diving to her left. Dot!
Touch fuller and on off, Smriti Mandhana hangs back and defends it to point.
Fuller again, Harmanpreet Kaur drives it past covers. The fielder chases it well. They collect two runs.
Another fuller one, outside off. Smriti Mandhana drives it to the right of mid off. The fielder does well to stop it. They take one.
Fuller one on off, Smriti Mandhana drives it but finds the fielder at mid off.
Freya Davies bowls it on off, Smriti Mandhana eases it to covers.
An outswinger outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur looks to defend it but gets an outside edge towards short third man. They collect one.
Low full toss outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur drives it to the fielder at extra covers.
Fuller one on off, Smriti Mandhana drives it straight towards the fielder at mid off. An end to another excellent over from Kate Cross.
On a length and on off, Smriti Mandhana looks to defend it but misses. Close!
Fuller one this time, Smriti Mandhana drives it but finds the fielder at covers.
On a length and on off, Smriti Mandhana eases it to the cover fielder.
Fuller one on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur flicks it to leg side for one.
Harmanpreet Kaur is the new batter in.

OUT! TIMBER! Another one bites the dust. On a length and on middle. The ball swings in a touch, Yastika Bhatia looks to play at it but misses. The ball knocks over the stumps and Kate Cross gets her second wicket. India Women need to build up a good stand now!
Fuller one on middle, Smriti Mandhana eases it to short covers. 8 runs from the over.
On a length and on off, Mandhana defends it to point.
FOUR! Sublime. Slightly shorter and on middle, Smriti Mandhana hangs back and punches it past covers for a boundary!
Fuller one on middle, Smriti Mandhana looks to block it but miscues it to point. Dot.
FOUR! Excellent timing. Fuller one on off, Smriti Mandhana creams it through covers for a boundary!
On a length and on off, Smriti Mandhana eases it to the off side.
Fuller one on off, Yastika Bhatia defends it solidly. An end to a wicket- maiden over from Kate Cross.
Yastika Bhatia comes in at number 3.

OUT! TIMBER! Kate Cross gets Shafali Verma once again in this series! This one lands on off and nips back in a long way. Shafali Verma looks to defend it but misses. It goes through the gap between bat and pad to rattle the stumps. Shafali Verma walks out for a duck and England Women have an early breakthrough in the game.
Touch fuller and on off, Shafali Verma covers her line and eases it to mid on.
On a length and outside off, this one nips back in. Shafali Verma looks to drive it but misses.
Length again, outside off. Shafali Verma gets in two minds but leaves it alone in the end.
On a length and on off, Shafali Verma defends it back towards Kate Cross.
Kate Cross to steam in from the other end.
On a length, around off. Smriti Mandhana dabs it to point. A dot to finish with. Just 2 runs of the over.
Play and a miss. Touch fuller and outside off, Smriti Mandhana looks to drive it but misses.
Length ball outside off, Mandhana leaves it alone.
Good length this time, Smriti Mandhana defends it back towards the bowler. Another dot.
Fuller again, around off. Smriti Mandhana eases it to mid on. Dot.
Starts with a fuller one outside off, Smriti Mandhana taps it towards deep backward point and gets off the mark. They collect two.

The game is set to begin. Glorious conditions at the home of cricket. The England Women players stride out to the middle. Followed by Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma who walk out to open for India Women. It will be Freya Davies to start with the new ball.

India Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Shafali Verma, Smriti Mandhana, Yastika Bhatia (WK), Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Harleen Deol, Pooja Vastrakar, Deepti Sharma, Dayalan Hemalatha, Rajeshwari Gayakwad, Renuka Singh, Jhulan Goswami.

England Women (Playing XI) - Emma Lamb, Tammy Beaumont, Sophia Dunkley, Alice Capsey, Danni Wyatt, Amy Jones (C/WK), Sophie Ecclestone, Freya Kemp, Charlotte Dean, Kate Cross, Freya Davies (In for Lauren Bell).
TOSS - England Women have won the toss and elected to BOWL first.

England Women have lost an ODI series against India at home after 23 years. Their bowlers could not have a solid control over their lines and lengths, and the batters also failed to gel properly in the last two matches. We can expect some changes on both sides for this encounter as it is a dead rubber, although there are some crucial Women's Championship points up for grabs. Let's see who comes out as a winner. Toss and team news are around the corner.
